3: Cap on how many zombies run their A-Life think step in one frame. The rest wait a frame or two, at most the time set in Zombie think wait limit. Zombies biting, attacking or right next to someone always think. Lower it if hordes near NPCs make the game stutter. 0 turns the cap off.
5: Longest a zombie waits for its think step when the per-frame cap is full. 200 is barely noticeable. With very large hordes, 600 together with 4 think steps per frame gives the most frames; around 1000 zombies start to bite less often.
